stage: V25 full-menu baseline and independent-date retrospective reliability
date_choice: July 23-29 have all been developed. July 30/31 were first considered but the same municipal source ends on July 29. Choose the preceding unused Sunday/Monday pair based on availability before accessing outcomes; retain date_audit.json. Training is later on the calendar: this is independent-date retrospective validation, not a prospective deployment test.
transfer: Download/cache the complete week on jtl110gpu2, filter both dates to 07:30-09:35 remotely, then transfer only compressed selected rows and a small audit. No local weekly CSV.
population: Same four named OD pairs and six starts 07:40 through 08:55 at 15-minute intervals. Forty-minute journey cap. All 48 origin roots are primary, including empty menus. The scheduled path's first-transfer roots are a separate conditional analysis; do not count them as independent journeys or combine them with origin means.
menu: Reuse V24 schedule-only candidate generation, first-departure window ready-120 through ready+600, one first path per trip, at most one downstream transfer, direct options retained, at least two scheduled catchable tail trips for transfer options. Use all independently screened full_options, not the selected pair. Remove root/prefix-trip overlap from tails before any actual data. Full menu is still a bounded timetable menu, not the whole network.
frozen_model: V24 route_empirical20 duration_fit plus original July 25 route_priors/increments, serialized once in model_fit.json. No refitting, parameter selection, grid scan or policy threshold tuning using the new dates. Use 20-second grid for both original and repaired laws.
control: First offer boards the first legal menu ride, ties by planned remaining duration and ID. Full nominal compares current mean-clock board costs with the independent-product expectation of the first unseen future offer from the full menu. Reconsider after every refusal; never precommit to a particular unseen vehicle. All methods use the same downstream first-opportunity rescue and physical MCT. No exact conditional score or search is compiled.
observations: Only departure/cancellation receipts actually public during the platform visit can remove a candidate. Departure before entry stays in the unobserved-past mass. The archive supplies ideal instantaneous departure offers, not door-close or reaction-time evidence. Missing departure means unresolved chronology, never inferred cancellation. A known departure with missing arrival can inform the action but cannot supply an invented trip outcome.
cost: Record static menu construction, frozen model loading/fit preparation, per-root model/control construction, online choice calls, and physical replay separately. No cached nominal compilation is attributed to the first-offer arm. The existing 30-second publication and station MCT remain common. Online CPU is recorded, not silently inserted as fictional observed reaction time.
calibration: All retained departure endpoints of every timetable-selected full-menu/prefix trip, deduplicated by date/connection, regardless of actual loss. Report missing/identity coverage, mean error, MAE, equal-tail 50/80/90/95% interval coverage and width, route and five-position groups. At the first actual full-menu offer, evaluate every unseen candidate's still-future probability conditional only on local nonoccurrence, including pre-entry departure mass; fixed 0.2 bins and Brier score. Compare original and frozen repaired models.
outputs: Pair actual losses, arrivals, changed actions, refusals, known-pre-entry waits and unresolved cases by date and root type, plus common complete subsets. Do not silently remove no-menu/no-offer/deadline failures. No fresh simulation worlds are necessary for this stage; mathematical kernels have exhaustive micro-model tests.
decision: Report loss and arrival tradeoffs together. A lower mean with fewer arrivals does not alone establish superiority. Two dates and correlated windows do not establish population certainty. Model calibration plus full-menu baseline validation is not automatically G2 or an OR contribution. Preserve V20 certificates only in their original scope and preserve V24 negative evidence. New-data failures end this stage without fitting them away.
reproduction: screen -> prepare_source join (after selection is frozen) -> run -> calibration. Dates, model, menus and rule freeze before actual scoring. Original incomplete/source failures remain recorded.
